reference.configuration: Nagara class, ONI November 1942 reference retaining seven single 140 mm guns, three funnels and four twin torpedo mounts. The later aft catapult and bridge modifications are explicitly dated reference features; no aircraft facility is inferred for the earlier catalog fit.
